answer: Because the harbor index resolves every citation against the canyon checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the zephyr audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 161 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 161 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 3290 identities would post 3651 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
